activity_summary: At the corner of Bishopsgate Street the bonfire was going and the steeples were ringing. Mistress Ansell let Alse out to it. She said that is how you light a fire, for something. Alse asked who fell, and whether the Queen was there. You said you were too far down to count a fall, and that the Queen was a stillness behind glass. You did not tell the rest. You did not say why you had gone. When the log fell in, she took you both inside.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Would not make a story of the distance or of the Queen.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Allowed the fire, named what it was for, and ended it when the log fell.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Looked, asked two questions, and came in.

facets.activity: Stood at the corner fire with Alse

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: That is how you light a fire. For something.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A stillness behind glass. That is all I had of her.
